Directed by the inimitable Richard Wallace, "A Kiss for Corliss" is a masterful blend of comedy and drama, starring the incomparable Shirley Temple in her final starring role. The film's narrative is a clever retelling of the 1945 film "Kiss and Tell," with a few tantalizing twists and turns that keep audiences guessing.

As the story unfolds, Corliss finds herself drawn to Kenneth's charms, despite his reputation as a ladies' man. But as their relationship deepens, secrets begin to surface, threatening to upend their love affair. Will Corliss be able to overcome her doubts and follow her heart, or will the pressures of her social status and Kenneth's past mistakes tear them apart?
